name: Heroku (and generic Procfile)

detect.signal: Procfile (generic: Heroku, Scalingo, Dokku, Cloud Run…)

web.detail: the app; start command set explicitly (CC_PYTHON_MODULE+backend, or CC_RUN_COMMAND)

worker.detail: CC_WORKER_COMMAND on the same app (no extra cost); a second app only for separate scaling

clock.detail: clevercloud/cron.json + job script (empty cron environment: variables from a 600 file written by CC_PRE_RUN_HOOK, guard ${INSTANCE_NUMBER:-0}) or CC_WORKER_COMMAND

release.detail: Django: CC_PYTHON_MANAGE_TASKS (runs at build); other stacks: CC_PRE_RUN_HOOK, idempotent (runs on every instance start)

components.platform_coupling: code that switches on DYNO / HEROKU_* (e.g. IS_HEROKU_APP) takes its production branch only on Heroku: make that switch explicit (env var) or ALLOWED_HOSTS/DB/HTTPS stay in local mode on Clever
components.app_json_generator_secret: generated on Clever with env-safe.sh generate NAME (value never printed)

traps: The production settings branch is gated on Heroku-only variables (DYNO): on Clever the app runs in local mode (ALLOWED_HOSTS local, SQLite) and answers 400 — which still PASSES the default health check (200-499).
Heroku's Python buildpack runs collectstatic automatically; Clever does not: CC_PYTHON_MANAGE_TASKS="collectstatic --noinput" (WhiteNoise manifest storage returns 500 otherwise).
release: phase → CC_PYTHON_MANAGE_TASKS runs during the build; with several instances anything in CC_PRE_RUN_HOOK runs on each.
Python version files (.python-version, runtime.txt): pin explicitly with CC_PYTHON_VERSION to an accepted version.
Config vars: copy with env-safe.sh push from a file the dev exports (heroku config -s > .env.heroku, untracked); never paste in chat.
DATABASE_URL: prefer reading POSTGRESQL_ADDON_URI in code (copied values do not follow credential rotation).
